ndbf49e129e.headline: UK homes already 'starting to suffer' with higher costs due to Iran war
ndbf49e129e.summary: Campaigners say the cost of heating oil continues to surge and has reached levels not seen since the early days of the Ukraine invasion. The rises are linked to the Iran war.
ndbf49e129e.why: Heating oil and energy costs feed directly into household budgets and UK inflation, which shapes Bank of England policy.

nbd4d0e92a3.headline: Delegation Formed to Inspect the Druzhba Oil Pipeline’s Condition
nbd4d0e92a3.summary: A five-member delegation was formed to examine the Druzhba oil pipeline and the Brody pumping station. The move follows uncertainty over whether Kyiv will resume oil deliveries.
nbd4d0e92a3.why: Druzhba is a key pipeline carrying Russian crude to Central Europe, so disruptions affect refinery supply in Hungary and neighbouring states.

n4fe47d6dd3.headline: Manufacturers warn expanded environmental levy could hurt competitiveness - Jamaica Observer
n4fe47d6dd3.summary: The Jamaica Manufacturers and Exporters Association warned that expanding the Environmental Protection Levy to 100 per cent of manufacturers' sales could weaken local goods. It said imports could gain an advantage.
n4fe47d6dd3.why: Levies on manufacturers change production costs and the competitiveness of domestic producers against imports.

na5bb46223e.headline: DBRS Confirms Greece BBB Rating
na5bb46223e.summary: DBRS confirmed Greece's sovereign credit rating at BBB with a stable outlook. It cited strong growth, fiscal discipline and debt reduction, while noting geopolitical risks.
na5bb46223e.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence government borrowing costs and investor demand for Greek government bonds.

nf289b30bdf.headline: Mom’s Belief Plans ₹100 Crore IPO, Rays Of Belief Targets Expansion Of Neurodevelopmental Centres
nf289b30bdf.summary: Rays of Belief Ltd, parent of Mom's Belief, plans to raise over Rs 100 crore through an IPO of 60 lakh fresh shares. Proceeds will fund expansion of neurodevelopmental care centres and technology.
nf289b30bdf.why: An IPO is a company's first sale of shares to the public, and it gives investors a way to participate in a company's growth.

nb775623782.headline: Qatar Warns Oil Could Hit $150/Barrel
nb775623782.summary: Qatar's Energy Minister warned that a Gulf conflict could halt exports and push oil prices to $150 a barrel, triggering global inflation.
nb775623782.why: Qatar is a major LNG exporter, and Gulf supply disruptions feed directly into global energy prices and inflation.
nb775623782.why_moved: The minister's warning of export halts and $150 oil points to a potential supply shock feeding global inflation.

n4234dfe69a.headline: DBRS Keeps Greece at BBB, Stable Outlook
n4234dfe69a.summary: DBRS affirmed Greece's sovereign rating at BBB with a stable outlook, citing fiscal discipline, debt reduction and reform continuity amid external risks.
n4234dfe69a.why: Sovereign ratings influence borrowing costs and investor perceptions of Greek government debt.

nf7b39050da.headline: Digi to go public with IPO of new shares worth between €150-200 million and IPO of its parent company, volume not yet disclosed
nf7b39050da.summary: Digi has detailed an upcoming IPO in Spain, a public offering of new shares worth between €150 million and €200 million, alongside an IPO of its parent company with volume not yet disclosed.
nf7b39050da.why: Digi is a telecom operator, and initial public offerings raise capital and set new listed equity for investors.

n0dd5b52fb6.headline: Sugar industry calls for national ethanol mandate amid Iran war oil shock
n0dd5b52fb6.summary: Australia's sugar industry says a national ethanol blending requirement could shield motorists from future oil market shocks. Only two states currently mandate ethanol blending.
n0dd5b52fb6.why: Ethanol blending links fuel demand to agricultural commodities and reduces dependence on imported crude oil.

n30953b9c04.headline: PM directs provinces to take legal action against petroleum hoarders
n30953b9c04.summary: The prime minister directed provinces to take legal action against petroleum hoarders. A dashboard will monitor the movement of petroleum products in real time.
n30953b9c04.why: Petroleum supply and hoarding controls affect fuel availability and retail prices across Pakistan's economy.

n08cdcb592a.headline: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
n08cdcb592a.summary: The Australian stock market kept its early losses in mid-market trading on Friday. The decline extended losses from the previous two sessions after negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
n08cdcb592a.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index and tracks the country's largest listed companies across banking, mining and energy.
n08cdcb592a.why_moved: Negative cues from Wall Street overnight weighed on Australian shares, extending losses from the previous two sessions.

nd75cfa445d.headline: Petronas Chemicals lifts Bursa’s key index to end higher
nd75cfa445d.summary: Petronas Chemicals shares surged more than 20% and lifted Bursa Malaysia's key index to end higher, as investors viewed the stock as a potential beneficiary of the Iran crisis.
nd75cfa445d.why: Petronas Chemicals is a Malaysian petrochemicals producer, and its share moves can significantly influence the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI index.

impacts.name: Petronas Chemicals
impacts.why: The stock surged more than 20% in the session described.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd75cfa445d.why_moved: Investors viewed Petronas Chemicals as a potential beneficiary of the Iran crisis, driving the stock sharply higher and lifting the index.

nbe5d13d767.headline: Dubai Tourism Hit by Aerial Attacks
nbe5d13d767.summary: Dubai's tourism and real estate sectors face severe disruption amid the Middle East conflict. Thousands of flights have been cancelled and hotels are emptying.
nbe5d13d767.why: Dubai is a major global aviation, tourism and property hub, so disruptions there affect airlines, hotels and real estate developers.

n4ba493b487.headline: ‘A foreign policy based on short memory’: Carney continues push to diversify from the U.S. - National | Globalnews.ca
n4ba493b487.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has shifted Canada's foreign policy toward the bottom line rather than values. The push is aimed at diversifying from the United States.
n4ba493b487.why: Canada's economy is closely tied to US trade, so diversification efforts affect exporters, tariffs exposure and the Canadian dollar.

n56d6208bd6.headline: Atenor SA Full Year Loss Widens
n56d6208bd6.summary: Atenor SA reported a full-year loss of EUR138.73 million, or EUR2.4 per share. This compares with a loss of EUR39 million in the prior period.
n56d6208bd6.why: Atenor is a Brussels-based property developer, and its results reflect the state of the Belgian real estate development market.

n6533f69567.headline: IMF: Oil Price Shock Tests Global Economic Resilience
n6533f69567.summary: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that the surge in oil and LNG prices from the Middle East war is testing global economic resilience and risks higher inflation.
n6533f69567.why: The IMF is the Washington-based lender that monitors global economic health, and its warnings shape policy expectations worldwide.

n49348dc7ee.headline: Qatar warns Gulf energy exports may halt within weeks if US-Iran conflict continues | Business
n49348dc7ee.summary: Qatar's energy minister Saad al-Kaabi said Gulf energy exporters could be forced to shut exports within weeks if the conflict involving Iran continues.
n49348dc7ee.why: Qatar is one of the world's largest exporters of liquefied natural gas, so disruptions there move global gas and energy markets.
n49348dc7ee.why_moved: A warning that Gulf energy exports may halt within weeks raises supply concerns across oil and gas markets.

n7ef9b257d0.headline: Middle East conflicts largely avoided energy facilities in the past. Not in this war
n7ef9b257d0.summary: Earlier regional conflicts largely spared energy facilities or caused limited damage. The U.S.-Israeli war with Iran is not following that pattern.
n7ef9b257d0.why: Damage to Gulf energy facilities can cut output and raise prices for oil and gas, which affects global markets.

na905258fdf.headline: ‘Why does India need America’s permission?’: Opposition slams US waiver on Russian oil
na905258fdf.summary: India's opposition criticised the government after the United States announced a temporary waiver allowing Indian refiners to buy Russian oil, amid rising West Asia tensions.
na905258fdf.why: Indian refiners are large buyers of crude, so changes in access to Russian barrels affect their feedstock costs and supply planning.

n7c70245bfa.headline: Nvidia sets $4 million target cash bonus for CEO Huang under fiscal 2027 plan
n7c70245bfa.summary: Nvidia adopted a variable compensation plan for fiscal 2027 with a target cash bonus of $4 million for CEO Jensen Huang, according to a regulatory filing.
n7c70245bfa.why: Nvidia is the leading designer of AI accelerator chips, and executive pay disclosures are reviewed by investors for governance.

n888f55c5b2.headline: Binance, Zhao win dismissal of lawsuit by victims of 64 attacks
n888f55c5b2.summary: A federal judge dismissed a civil lawsuit seeking to hold Binance and founder Changpeng Zhao liable, brought by victims of 64 attacks.
n888f55c5b2.why: Binance is one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges by trading volume, so legal rulings against it affect regulatory and litigation risk across the crypto sector.

nb5d1e1f6a4.headline: Iran launches large-scale retaliatory strikes on Tel Aviv amid ongoing conflict
nb5d1e1f6a4.summary: Iran carried out extensive retaliatory attacks on Israel, deploying dozens of drones and missiles as military escalation intensified.
nb5d1e1f6a4.why: Escalation between Iran and Israel raises regional security risk that feeds into oil prices, shipping and investor sentiment.

nf408647fbf.headline: Wealthy Asians move Dubai assets amid Iran war fears
nf408647fbf.summary: Affluent Asians are moving assets parked in Dubai to Singapore and Hong Kong as the US-Israel war on Iran clouds the Gulf's safe-haven appeal.
nf408647fbf.why: Dubai is a major wealth and real estate hub, so capital outflows affect property markets and financial flows in the Gulf.

nb15e5515b6.headline: Market Spotlight Still On Middle East War
nb15e5515b6.summary: Global market sentiment remains closely linked to the Middle East war and the rise in oil prices that has followed.
nb15e5515b6.why: Broad risk sentiment across equities, bonds and currencies tends to track energy shocks during geopolitical conflicts.

nc6f13222a3.headline: Panic Selling Triggers Massive Slide as Pakistan Stock Market Loses Over 3,000 Points
nc6f13222a3.summary: Pakistan's benchmark KSE-100 index plunged more than 3,000 points in early trading on Friday. The sudden fall raised investor concerns about the stability of the financial sector.
nc6f13222a3.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the largest listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi.
nc6f13222a3.why_moved: The report describes panic selling by investors, with concern about market stability following a previous decline.

nb5ec541aca.headline: Ringgit ends week mixed as dollar gains amid Middle East conflict
nb5ec541aca.summary: The ringgit ended the week mixed as the US dollar gained amid the Middle East conflict. An analyst said market sentiment will remain focused on the war in Iran.
nb5ec541aca.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves reflect foreign capital flows and regional risk sentiment.

nf0088e7f19.headline: US military shows footage of Iranian drone carrier on fire after strikes. See how the day unfolded. - The Boston Globe
nf0088e7f19.summary: Israel's military said it began a broad-scale wave of strikes on Tehran early Friday. The US military released footage of an Iranian drone carrier on fire after strikes.
nf0088e7f19.why: Escalation of direct military conflict involving Iran raises risks to oil flows and to regional stability that global markets track.
nf0088e7f19.why_moved: Escalation of military strikes on Tehran raises geopolitical risk and supply concerns in oil markets.

n8b97246b20.headline: Chandra Asri declares force majeure amid Hormuz disruption
n8b97246b20.summary: PT Chandra Asri Pacific has declared force majeure after the US-Israel war with Iran disrupted feedstock shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
n8b97246b20.why: Chandra Asri is Indonesia's largest petrochemical company, and it depends on imported feedstock for its production.

n13676946d6.headline: Vietnam is booming, but foreign cash is fleeing from stocks
n13676946d6.summary: Foreign sellers say investing in Vietnam is hindered by tariff risks, ownership limits and one firm's dominance of the index, even as the economy is booming.
n13676946d6.why: Foreign ownership limits and index concentration affect how much international capital flows into Vietnam's stock market.

n1d52ec5f51.headline: Indonesia calls WTO fisheries subsidy ban unfair to developing nations
n1d52ec5f51.summary: Indonesia views the standardized WTO fisheries subsidy ban under the Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies as unfair. The position was stated in the context of developing-country trade rules.
n1d52ec5f51.why: The WTO sets global trade rules, and fisheries subsidy disciplines affect fleet economics and seafood trade.

n54a6892d56.headline: Foreign investors withdraw $2 billion from Egyptian markets amid regional tensions
n54a6892d56.summary: Foreign investors sold over $2 billion in Egyptian government debt within four days amid regional tensions, while local and Arab investors bought shares, stabilizing the stock market.
n54a6892d56.why: Egypt's financial markets are sensitive to geopolitical risks; large foreign capital outflows can pressure debt and equity markets and impact currency and borrowing costs.
n54a6892d56.why_moved: Regional tensions triggered foreign investor sell-off of Egyptian government debt, impacting market stability.

nda184552bc.headline: Lufthansa Stock Gains On Positive FY26 Outlook, Despite Weak FY25 Net Profit
nda184552bc.summary: Deutsche Lufthansa AG shares gained about 3% after the company projected significantly higher adjusted EBIT for fiscal 2026 despite a weak net profit in 2025.
nda184552bc.why: Airline earnings outlooks affect investor sentiment and sector valuations, reflecting expectations for travel demand and operational recovery.
nda184552bc.why_moved: The positive fiscal 2026 EBIT outlook improved investor confidence, driving Lufthansa shares higher despite weak 2025 results.

n01ffde8593.headline: Where does Europe stand on the US-Israel war with Iran?
n01ffde8593.summary: As the US-Israel conflict with Iran intensifies, Europe faces potential threats and is developing strategic responses to the evolving situation.
n01ffde8593.why: European security concerns and economic exposure to Middle East conflicts affect trade, energy supplies, and geopolitical risk assessments.
